description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling the DeleteFeatureDefinition command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It processes deletion requests for feature definitions of a Thing, generates appropriate events or error results, and manages entity tags for concurrency control.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: Final class that provides the implementation strategy for deleting feature definitions in a Thing. Extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy specialized for DeleteFeatureDefinition commands, supporting the deletion process and entity tag management.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the deletion logic for a feature definition, returning a Result with a ThingEvent or error based on whether the feature exists.

methods.name: getDeleteFeatureDefinitionResult
methods.description: Constructs a Result indicating successful deletion with an event, or an error if the feature definition is not found.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the previous entity state for concurrency control, based on the feature's current definition.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating no specific entity tag after the operation.
